fields.name: By the big skeleton
fields.notes:
Who's here?

- Jago, callsign Emerald
- Ruskyn, callsign Rat

What happens?

- Mission accomplished: Retrieved the box. It contains a large heart made of stone. The heart is symbolic, but shows anatomically correct veins.
- Jago experiments with the intertwined chair, and crosses the river, there and back, naked, wet and cold.
- Jago makes the skeleton's skull pretty, restoring his frazzled spirits.
- Jago takes the box containing the stone heart

fields.name: Crossing the river
fields.notes: Teleportation chairs on opposite sides of river

fields.name: Riding to the lake
fields.notes:
Meeting local from the Hole, come to work (waiting for the others), Jago checks the edge of the hole (30 m wide). The lake is very, very still. And clear.

mäki hävisi montuksi. sieltä tuli smurffiina (Hall folk), jutteli urakasta ja hyppäsi takaisin koloon.

fields.name: On the shore
fields.notes: Lake is too placid, water is clear but soon visibility vanishes to darkess. Some things big are moving in the water.

fields.name: Negotiations
fields.notes: Farmer Demelza brought over, accusations of theft acknowledged, one Holfolker falls to Lake & gets eaten by dark under surface shape, "leader" lady Gruff struck unconscious, two ran away. Crystal returned to farmer, payment is visit to their village.

fields.name: To Demelza's village
fields.notes: Gruff tied to Jago's steed.

fields.name: At Demelza's village - Rootone, The Citadel of Pipes
fields.notes: On top of a hill a monument of upright pipes. Demelza's larvae is a slow mover.

fields.name: Rootone - village meet
fields.notes:
Jago's message (from Unnamed); your hand will be on the Key at the hour of sotution.
[Connected to the essence of the Precogs]

Ratkin's message (from precog Rising One): will you be worthy, when you are the ruler of the "Underdark"

"Blue person" will be taken by the Vanguarders & Demenza to the Seat of Power.

fields.name: River - going under it
fields.notes: A cave supported entrance, dark.

fields.name: Sleeping outside
fields.notes: Guarding in order Demelza, Ruskyn, Jago (Gruff restrained)

fields.name: Approaching Seat of Power
fields.notes:
Jago's steed slowing, getting 'shroom advice.

An old graying traveler, Caldan, also heading there on their spoke (to see their niese).

Caldan proposes that there is a heavy load - The Heart! Move it to the other steed.

Finally seeing the tall, dark tower - from floor to ceiling - and they have reached the Seat of Power... and it is the Tower, no city around it.

fields.name: In the Tower
fields.notes:
Jago on cleaver, Ruskyn on paikallinen....

Tornin tasot...

viljelyä pohjalla
asutusta
kauppataso
puutarhausta (enemmän fiilistä, vähemmän konkretriaa) vesialtailla, ja hallintotaso palatsilla keskellä
ylempää jostain kirkas valo
 
"Auringonvalo" tulee korkeammalta, hallintotaso on kuitenkin vielä alimmalla kolmanneksella 

Hallintopöydän ympärillä reagointi sheriffiin on jotenkin varautunut, korkeintaan nyökkälllään, joku tuolikin on tyhjä 

Nuori nainen  pöydän päässä sangen naamat

Näillä ei ole samaa kuvaa ylämaailmasta kuten meillä, uskovat että siellä on ylempi luola josta ruskeat hyökkivät (joita oli myös se naamat ollut nuori nainen).

Näkijä tietää lisää, mutta alueella on kulkijoita kadonnut, Caldanilta niin tarkkaa dataa kuin vioidaan saada, Echolowin kaupunki, Deepsiren uskollinen vasallikaupunki

Saadaan lahjaksi huimat veitset (yleisö kohahtaa)

notes.4,4:
Seat of Power

- Myghal, the Primary, Boulder (3/5)

### Deepsire - Seat of Power

- Tower raising to the roof of the cave
- Covered with downward-facing spikes
- Inside harsh sunlight
- Tiers raising to primary level
- Middle/entrance tier is markets and plots
- Below, the abyss

- Primary - Myghal, Boulderkin (3-5), Academic at heart, painful memories of war, mumbled, friendly voice, device on everything is a metallic eye
- Secret successor - Foxter, the Storied one (3-1)
- Hostage - Viralag, daughter of Ruan, drunken workshipper of the Tumbled Tower
- Sheriff - Caldan, Molekin (4-6) - a humble beast, no roar or flight, beneath the grey a show of might
notes.4,2:
- Brittle ferns
- Drowned seat
- Rapid waters
notes.6,2:
### Rootone

- Citadel of pipes and pipers
- Things are in **decline**, because war claimed the young people
- Leader Demelza, grower of prize crystals, hopes to gain renown in the city and to attract new young families
- Old maid Thubolt, mythwise
notes.5,0: Offering plinth, 90 degrees from the vertical
notes.7,3:
- Oracle font
- **Kerensa, The Spectral Seer 3-11**
    - Immaterial shadow of a life long extinguished, restricted to dwell near an urn containing their remains.
    - Sees all events that include death: past, present, and future.
    - Wants to return to a physical form.
notes.8,7:
- Sanctum: Cool meadow
- **Wattle, the Veiled Seer**
- Hanging folds of flesh and horse-like hair hide any semblance of a face.
- Sees nothing, but hears all within a Hex.
- Speaks just once each day, giving a single word of advice to the most worthy visitor.
- Genuinely wants to uphold peace.
notes.11,6:
- Sanctum: Sheltered trench, upside down
- **Pryer, the Buried Seer**
- Trapped far beneath our feet, but speaks to those who stand at her gravestone, adorned with black flowers.
- Sees all below the ground, and hears all on the surface. Blind to water and sky.
- Wants to hurry along the inevitable death of everyone and everything.

fields.name: People
fields.notes:
# Areas & People

### Main cavern - The Massive

- Large eyes, strangely attractive
- Melodic voice, precise diction
- Olive green skin

### Top cavern - Cleavers

- Fiery, passionate, burn bright but not as long
- Grating voice
- Deep brown skin, hint of red

### Hinterlands a.k.a. Reeds

- Cold and hard, both in demeanor and to the touch
- Cautious, only interested in taking care of their animals
- Talk in whispers, if at all

fields.name: Animals
fields.notes:
- A giant cave salamander — pale, blind, and slow-growing in underground lakes. Think axolotl-meets-chicken: mild, slightly sweet white meat with a delicate texture, farmed in flooded cavern systems lit by bioluminescent fungi.
- Spindly roaches - local version of rats, run really fast on four legs when threatened, surprisingly hard to kill, squeeze through really small cracks, eat anything organic, avoid torchlight but gather just outside its edge.
